items.html: And it was already explained above that just as the lower is included from the upper, so too is the upper included from the lower, and now it is found that the totality of the Yesod is in that third of Tiferet. And it is found how many extra lights there are in that lower third of the Tiferet of Arich, and therefore it sufficed to make three Mochin in ZA. And it is found that from the phase of the Kelim of the seven kings, the phase of the six extremities of ZA was clarified and made from them, in the phase of Kelim, and likewise in the sparks, and likewise in the lights, as mentioned above.
